page_title: LOR 1-4 PSG | Lorient v PSG 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Marc Bollengier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Panos Katseris (Lorient) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+6' Panos Katseris (Lorient) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lorient.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 4 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani slips a clever pass through to Kylian Mbappe (PSG), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 1:4.
89' A cross from Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
87' Unlucky! A great strike from Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
87' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

85' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
84' Ethan Mbappe (PSG) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
82' A quickly taken corner by PSG.

82' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
80' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Laurent Abergel (Lorient) causes Gianluigi Donnarumma little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
80' Panos Katseris (Lorient) gets inside the box and tries to beat Gianluigi Donnarumma with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
80' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Ethan Mbappe (PSG) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
79' Substitution. Gedeon Kalulu walks off the pitch and Panos Katseris (Lorient) comes on as a substitute.
79' PENALTY APPEAL after Julien Ponceau (Lorient) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
78' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
77' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) jumps into a tackle and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.

75' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.

73' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) bravely launches himself at a cross from Benjamin Mendy and gives Gianluigi Donnarumma no chance with a close-range bullet header into the top right corner. 1:3.
73' PSG take a short corner kick.
73' The game has come to an end for Nuno Mendes. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ethan Mbappe (PSG).

72' What a wasted opportunity by Kylian Mbappe (PSG)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top left corner, but Yvon Mvogo makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
72' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) and blew his whistle.
71' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
71' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
70' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
69' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) replacing Eli Junior Kroupi.
68' Substitution. Imran Louza did his best and is replaced by Laurent Abergel (Lorient).
67' Yoram Zague (PSG) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
67' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
65' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball.
64' Here is a change. Lucas Hernandez is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Nordi Mukiele (PSG).
63' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marc Bollengier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
62' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Goncalo Ramos.
61' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Senny Mayulu is replaced by Carlos Soler (PSG).
61' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Kang-In Lee will be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (PSG).
61' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) replaces Ayman Kari.
61' Substitution. Darlin Yongwa makes way for Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
60' 0 - 3 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Kylian Mbappe, then sends the ball into the middle of the net. 0:3.
59' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient). Marc Bollengier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
58' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lorient.
56' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
53' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) tries to find Ayman Kari, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
51' Nuno Mendes (PSG) was too forceful with his tackle and Marc Bollengier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:4.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) commits a rough foul. Marc Bollengier stops the game and makes a call.
42' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
42' Nuno Mendes (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
40' The ball possession at the moment is 39:61.
38' So close! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
38' Isaak Toure (Lorient) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. PSG are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' A poor finish by Julien Ponceau (Lorient) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
31' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
31' Lorient force a corner. They send men into the box.

31' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Lorient force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' Senny Mayulu (PSG) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
28' Imran Louza (Lorient) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
27' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
26' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' Marc Bollengier shows the yellow card to Nuno Mendes (PSG) for a heavy challenge.
26' The game is interrupted now, Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Nuno Mendes (PSG) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
22' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) takes a short pass from Nuno Mendes in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.

19' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Yvon Mvogo was helpless.

19' Julien Laporte (Lorient) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma keeps it out.
19' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) will take the free kick.
18' Nuno Mendes (PSG) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece. Free kick. Lorient will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
17' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
16' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
14' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
12' Ayman Kari (Lorient) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Imran Louza and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
7' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
2' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

2' Kang-In Lee (PSG) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
PSG will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier was nominated as the referee for this game.
